vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek sets out to find A person, maybe 60s, with freckles. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
🚶 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is back — found A person, maybe 60s, with freckles.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Riley and Brian met them at the door — 2 put down. Riley, Brian are hurt.
🛡️ Riley, Waleed, Hannah and Brian met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Riley, Waleed, Hannah, Brian are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Riley just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nina just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Riley and Nina met them at the door — 2 put down. Riley, Nina are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Riley just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Lena, Riley, Waleed, Hannah and Brian met them at the door — 5 put down. Riley, Waleed, Hannah are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Henry, Aria and Aroha met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Henry, Aria, Aroha are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ Two threats: Pack-leader The Focus Group (×2) and an eye-head (×6) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Waleed was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
Riley showed Vasylyna the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
